column2: Sound effect only, no music, no voice: one short soft bubbly bloop of a toy underwater bubble gun firing a single bubble. Cute cartoon video game sound, very short, about 0.3 seconds.
Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a small cartoon torpedo launching underwater, a quick whoosh with a fizzy trail of bubbles. Fun video game sound, about 0.8 seconds.
Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a muffled underwater explosion, a deep soft thump and rumble followed by a rush of bubbles. Cartoon video game sound, not scary, about 1.2 seconds.

Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a small toy robot breaking apart underwater, a metallic clank and bonk with springs and bolts popping off, then a fizz of bubbles. Funny cartoon video game sound, about 0.8 seconds.
Sound effect only, no voice: a short happy magical chime with sparkly rising bubbles, a cute sea creature is freed from a cage. Joyful cartoon video game reward sound, about 1 second.
Sound effect only, no music, no human voice: a friendly baby dolphin's happy clicks and whistle chirps saying thank you. Cute, bright, about 1 second.
Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a short electric zap buzz from a robot jellyfish, crackling but soft and not harsh. Cartoon video game sound, about 0.5 seconds.
Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a cartoon pufferfish inflating like a balloon, a rising stretchy rubbery squeak, ending in a tiny pop. Funny video game sound, about 0.9 seconds.
Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a sneaky robotic hiss followed by a quick slithering lunge whoosh underwater. Cartoon video game sound, about 0.6 seconds.
Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a wet cartoon squirt of ink from a robot octopus underwater, a squishy splat. Video game sound, about 0.4 seconds.

Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a small yellow submarine hatch closing with a metal clunk and a hiss of air, then a little propeller motor whirring on. Cartoon video game sound, about 1 second.

Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a giant funny robot octopus arrives underwater, a deep electronic foghorn roar with a metallic groan and big bubbles. Comic and exciting, not scary, for kids. About 2 seconds.
Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a heavy underwater swoosh of a giant robot tentacle sweeping past. Cartoon video game sound, about 0.7 seconds.

Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a giant comic robot octopus deflating underwater, a descending whistle like a balloon losing air, a sputtering motor, bubbly blub blub sounds and clattering bolts. Funny cartoon ending, about 2.5 seconds.
Sound effect only, no music, no voice: a toy robot crab's claw cannon locking on with mechanical clicks, then a small pop as it fires a shell underwater. Cartoon video game sound, about 0.7 seconds.
No music, no voice: calm underwater ambience, soft distant bubbles, a gentle muffled ocean hum and faint far-off whale song. Peaceful and seamless background, about 12 seconds.
